title: 紐約第二大道地鐵一期
summary: 以紐約第二大道地鐵一期為背景，建立密集街廓下方新站與既有線銜接的教學剖面。課程把測量、灌漿、施工時間窗口及乘客垂直交通結合，要求分開施工變形控制和營運期人流驗證，並保留不確定度。
summaryEn: Use Second Avenue Subway Phase 1 to construct a teaching section with new stations beneath dense city blocks and a connection to an existing line. Combine surveying, grouting, possession windows and vertical passenger movement. Keep construction-movement control distinct from operational passenger-flow validation, and retain uncertainty rather than treating one instrument reading as a complete statement about building or station performance.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 控制網與獨立量測殘差與沉陷差與軌道坡折
stages.titleEn: Survey control and independent residuals & Differential settlement and track kink
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「控制網與獨立量測殘差」與「沉陷差與軌道坡折」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Survey control and independent residuals" and "Differential settlement and track kink": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 控制網與獨立量測殘差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Survey control and independent residuals: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「控制網與獨立量測殘差」如何影響紐約第二大道地鐵一期的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Survey control and independent residuals” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Second Avenue Subway Phase 1”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 兩套獨立量測可用座標差的平方和開根號描述平面殘差，但這只是對照量而不是絕對準確度。共同基點錯誤會同時影響兩套結果，控制網需要閉合檢查及外部基準才能發現系統偏差。 兩座標差的歐氏長度表示平面殘差大小，不是隨機標準差。先把兩套座標轉到相同基準和單位，再檢查各方向偏差；共同平移可能讓相對殘差很小但絕對位置仍錯。 對街區水準測量做閉合檢核並以穩定外部基準控制漂移。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「控制網與獨立量測殘差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The root-sum-square of coordinate differences describes planar residual between independent measurements, not absolute accuracy. A shared control-point error affects both results. Network closure and an external datum are needed to reveal systematic bias that agreement alone can conceal. The Euclidean length of two coordinate differences measures planar residual, not random standard deviation. Transform both coordinate sets to one datum and unit before inspecting directional differences. Common translation can leave a small relative residual while absolute position remains wrong. Check closure in block-level levelling and control drift against a stable external datum. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Survey control and independent residuals” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：dx=0.003 m; dy=0.004 m；計算：residual=(dx*dx+dy*dy)**0.5*1000=5 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: dx=0.003 m; dy=0.004 m; calculation: residual=(dx*dx+dy*dy)**0.5*1000=5 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩台儀器量得同樣座標就證明座標絕對正確」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Matching coordinates from two instruments prove absolute coordinate accuracy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「控制網與獨立量測殘差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Survey control and independent residuals”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 控制網與獨立量測殘差
knowledge.text: 兩套獨立量測可用座標差的平方和開根號描述平面殘差，但這只是對照量而不是絕對準確度。共同基點錯誤會同時影響兩套結果，控制網需要閉合檢查及外部基準才能發現系統偏差。
knowledge.textEn: The root-sum-square of coordinate differences describes planar residual between independent measurements, not absolute accuracy. A shared control-point error affects both results.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩台儀器量得同樣座標就證明座標絕對正確 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Matching coordinates from two instruments prove absolute coordinate accuracy. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「控制網與獨立量測殘差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Survey control and independent residuals" is correct?
options: 兩台儀器量得同樣座標就證明座標絕對正確
兩套獨立量測可用座標差的平方和開根號描述平面殘差，但這只是對照量而不是絕對準確度。
兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷
optionsEn: Matching coordinates from two instruments prove absolute coordinate accuracy.
The root-sum-square of coordinate differences describes planar residual between independent measurements, not absolute accuracy.
Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them.
quiz.explanation: 兩套獨立量測可用座標差的平方和開根號描述平面殘差，但這只是對照量而不是絕對準確度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The root-sum-square of coordinate differences describes planar residual between independent measurements, not absolute accuracy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 控制網與獨立量測殘差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Survey control and independent residuals: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「控制網與獨立量測殘差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Survey control and independent residuals” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：dx=0.003 m; dy=0.004 m；計算：residual=(dx*dx+dy*dy)**0.5*1000=5 mm。敏感度：dx 單獨增加百分之十至 0.0033 m，其餘固定，結果為 5.185557 mm。模型邊界：平面兩分量殘差；不含座標轉換協方差和垂直誤差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: dx=0.003 m; dy=0.004 m; calculation: residual=(dx*dx+dy*dy)**0.5*1000=5 mm. Sensitivity: dx, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.0033 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 5.185557 mm. Model boundary: Planar two-component residual; transformation covariance and vertical error are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用獨立控制點做閉合觀測，記錄儀器溫度、氣壓改正與視線長度，將重複性和系統偏差分開報告。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Close observations on independent controls, record instrument temperature, pressure correction and sight length, and report repeatability separately from systematic bias.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：dx=0.003 m; dy=0.004 m；計算：residual=(dx*dx+dy*dy)**0.5*1000=5 mm。敏感度：dx 單獨增加百分之十至 0.0033 m，其餘固定，結果為 5.185557 mm。模型邊界：平面兩分量殘差；不含座標轉換協方差和垂直誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: dx=0.003 m; dy=0.004 m; calculation: residual=(dx*dx+dy*dy)**0.5*1000=5 mm. Sensitivity: dx, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.0033 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 5.185557 mm. Model boundary: Planar two-component residual; transformation covariance and vertical error are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「控制網與獨立量測殘差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Survey control and independent residuals", which statement holds?
options: 施工窗口全長都可以直接乘以施工速度當成可完成量
風機已經啟動就能證明隧道每一處濃度同樣下降
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：dx=0.003 m; dy=0.004 m。
optionsEn: The entire possession duration can be multiplied by work rate to obtain achievable production.
A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel.
Original hypothetical exercise.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：dx=0.003 m; dy=0.004 m；計算：residual=(dx*dx+dy*dy)**0.5*1000=5 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: dx=0.003 m; dy=0.004 m; calculation: residual=(dx*dx+dy*dy)**0.5*1000=5 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 控制網與獨立量測殘差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Survey control and independent residuals: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「控制網與獨立量測殘差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Survey control and independent residuals” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用獨立控制點做閉合觀測，記錄儀器溫度、氣壓改正與視線長度，將重複性和系統偏差分開報告。 以反向觀測、閉合路線和外部基準交叉檢核，分開報告平面殘差與可疑共同偏差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Close observations on independent controls, record instrument temperature, pressure correction and sight length, and report repeatability separately from systematic bias. Cross-check reversed observations, closed loops and external references, reporting planar residual separately from suspected shared bias. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：加入一個共同平移偏差，檢查兩儀器殘差與外部基準差異，提出能辨識系統誤差的控制網配置。 再以本單元 dx 的對照值重算 residual，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add a shared translation bias, compare inter-instrument residual with error to an external datum, and propose a control network that can reveal systematic error. Also recalculate residual for the alternative dx value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同一錯誤基點會讓兩台儀器一致偏移；長視線折光與站體熱變形也可能被誤認為施工偏差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: One wrong datum can shift both instruments consistently; long-sight refraction and thermal movement can also be mistaken for construction error. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用獨立控制點做閉合觀測，記錄儀器溫度、氣壓改正與視線長度，將重複性和系統偏差分開報告。 以反向觀測、閉合路線和外部基準交叉檢核，分開報告平面殘差與可疑共同偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Close observations on independent controls, record instrument temperature, pressure correction and sight length, and report repeatability separately from systematic bias. Cross-check reversed observations, closed loops and external references, reporting planar residual separately from suspected shared bias.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 加入一個共同平移偏差，檢查兩儀器殘差與外部基準差異，提出能辨識系統誤差的控制網配置。 再以本單元 dx 的對照值重算 residual，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Add a shared translation bias, compare inter-instrument residual with error to an external datum, and propose a control network that can reveal systematic error. Also recalculate residual for the alternative dx value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「控制網與獨立量測殘差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Survey control and independent residuals"?
options: 用獨立控制點做閉合觀測，記錄儀器溫度、氣壓改正與視線長度，將重複性和系統偏差分開報告。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位
optionsEn: Close observations on independent controls, record instrument temperature, pressure correction and sight length, and report repeatability separately from systematic bias.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
quiz.explanation: 用獨立控制點做閉合觀測，記錄儀器溫度、氣壓改正與視線長度，將重複性和系統偏差分開報告。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Close observations on independent controls, record instrument temperature, pressure correction and sight length, and report repeatability separately from systematic bias. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 控制網與獨立量測殘差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Survey control and independent residuals: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「控制網與獨立量測殘差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Survey control and independent residuals” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 同一錯誤基點會讓兩台儀器一致偏移；長視線折光與站體熱變形也可能被誤認為施工偏差。 閉合良好仍可能全部同向漂移，須使用外部穩定基準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One wrong datum can shift both instruments consistently; long-sight refraction and thermal movement can also be mistaken for construction error. Good closure can coexist with common drift; an external stable reference remains necessary. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對街區水準測量做閉合檢核並以穩定外部基準控制漂移。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Check closure in block-level levelling and control drift against a stable external datum.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩台儀器量得同樣座標就證明座標絕對正確」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Matching coordinates from two instruments prove absolute coordinate accuracy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 同一錯誤基點會讓兩台儀器一致偏移；長視線折光與站體熱變形也可能被誤認為施工偏差。 閉合良好仍可能全部同向漂移，須使用外部穩定基準。
knowledge.textEn: One wrong datum can shift both instruments consistently; long-sight refraction and thermal movement can also be mistaken for construction error. Good closure can coexist with common drift; an external stable reference remains necessary.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「控制網與獨立量測殘差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Survey control and independent residuals" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
同一錯誤基點會讓兩台儀器一致偏移；長視線折光與站體熱變形也可能被誤認為施工偏差。
兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
One wrong datum can shift both instruments consistently; long-sight refraction and thermal movement can also be mistaken for construction error.
Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them.
quiz.explanation: 同一錯誤基點會讓兩台儀器一致偏移；長視線折光與站體熱變形也可能被誤認為施工偏差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: One wrong datum can shift both instruments consistently; long-sight refraction and thermal movement can also be mistaken for construction error. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and track kink: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「沉陷差與軌道坡折」如何影響紐約第二大道地鐵一期的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Differential settlement and track kink” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Second Avenue Subway Phase 1”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 均勻沉陷主要改變高程，短距離差異沉陷則改變軌道坡度和車輪動態荷載。兩端高差除以基長只給平均坡度，無法描述局部尖峰；需要多點剖面才能辨認曲率與變形長度。 相同端點坡度可以對應完全不同的中間形狀，因此坡度不能單獨表示軌道曲率。測點間距必須小於欲辨認的變形尺度，並將高程誤差相對於基長傳遞到坡度結果。 將建築兩端高差與中間沉陷槽分開，檢查測點密度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「沉陷差與軌道坡折」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Uniform settlement mainly changes elevation, whereas differential settlement over a short distance alters track slope and dynamic wheel loading. End-to-end difference divided by baseline gives only an average gradient, not a local peak. A spatial profile is needed to identify curvature and deformation length. Identical endpoint gradient can hide very different intermediate shapes, so gradient alone cannot describe track curvature. Survey spacing must resolve the deformation length scale, and elevation uncertainty must be propagated relative to the baseline into the reported gradient. Separate end-to-end building difference from an intermediate trough and inspect point spacing. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Differential settlement and track kink” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：drop=0.012 m; baseline=20 m；計算：gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.6 mm/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: drop=0.012 m; baseline=20 m; calculation: gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.6 mm/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「沉陷差與軌道坡折」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Differential settlement and track kink”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折
knowledge.text: 均勻沉陷主要改變高程，短距離差異沉陷則改變軌道坡度和車輪動態荷載。兩端高差除以基長只給平均坡度，無法描述局部尖峰；需要多點剖面才能辨認曲率與變形長度。
knowledge.textEn: Uniform settlement mainly changes elevation, whereas differential settlement over a short distance alters track slope and dynamic wheel loading. End-to-end difference divided by baseline gives only an average gradient, not a local peak.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「沉陷差與軌道坡折」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Differential settlement and track kink" is correct?
options: 兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷
注入漿量超過幾何空隙體積就能證明沒有殘留空洞
均勻沉陷主要改變高程，短距離差異沉陷則改變軌道坡度和車輪動態荷載。
optionsEn: Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them.
Injecting more than the geometric void volume proves that no void remains.
Uniform settlement mainly changes elevation, whereas differential settlement over a short distance alters track slope and dynamic wheel loading.
quiz.explanation: 均勻沉陷主要改變高程，短距離差異沉陷則改變軌道坡度和車輪動態荷載。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Uniform settlement mainly changes elevation, whereas differential settlement over a short distance alters track slope and dynamic wheel loading. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and track kink: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「沉陷差與軌道坡折」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Differential settlement and track kink” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：drop=0.012 m; baseline=20 m；計算：gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.6 mm/m。敏感度：drop 單獨增加百分之十至 0.0132 m，其餘固定，結果為 0.66 mm/m。模型邊界：小變形平均坡度；不計車軌耦合動力或容許軌道幾何。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: drop=0.012 m; baseline=20 m; calculation: gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.6 mm/m. Sensitivity: drop, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.0132 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.66 mm/m. Model boundary: Small-deformation average gradient; vehicle-track dynamics and permissible geometry limits are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：drop=0.012 m; baseline=20 m；計算：gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.6 mm/m。敏感度：drop 單獨增加百分之十至 0.0132 m，其餘固定，結果為 0.66 mm/m。模型邊界：小變形平均坡度；不計車軌耦合動力或容許軌道幾何。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: drop=0.012 m; baseline=20 m; calculation: gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.6 mm/m. Sensitivity: drop, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.0132 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.66 mm/m. Model boundary: Small-deformation average gradient; vehicle-track dynamics and permissible geometry limits are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「沉陷差與軌道坡折」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Differential settlement and track kink", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：drop=0.012 m; baseline=20 m。
兩台電扶梯的實際總輸送率必定等於單台額定值兩倍
只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞
optionsEn: Original hypothetical exercise.
Two escalators necessarily deliver twice the rated throughput of one escalator.
Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：drop=0.012 m; baseline=20 m；計算：gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.6 mm/m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: drop=0.012 m; baseline=20 m; calculation: gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.6 mm/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and track kink: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「沉陷差與軌道坡折」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Differential settlement and track kink” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。 重複觀測同一測點並做閉合檢核，以另一穩定基準核對零點，報告高差與基長各自誤差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift. Repeat identical points with closure checks, verify zero against another stable reference, and report separate errors for elevation difference and baseline. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：構造端點相同但中間下陷的剖面，與直線坡度模型比較；提出足以辨識沉陷槽寬度的測點間距與複測頻率。 再以本單元 drop 的對照值重算 gradient，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Construct a profile with equal endpoints and an intermediate trough, compare it with a straight-gradient model, and propose spacing and repeat intervals able to resolve the trough. Also recalculate gradient for the alternative drop value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。 重複觀測同一測點並做閉合檢核，以另一穩定基準核對零點，報告高差與基長各自誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift. Repeat identical points with closure checks, verify zero against another stable reference, and report separate errors for elevation difference and baseline.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 構造端點相同但中間下陷的剖面，與直線坡度模型比較；提出足以辨識沉陷槽寬度的測點間距與複測頻率。 再以本單元 drop 的對照值重算 gradient，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Construct a profile with equal endpoints and an intermediate trough, compare it with a straight-gradient model, and propose spacing and repeat intervals able to resolve the trough. Also recalculate gradient for the alternative drop value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「沉陷差與軌道坡折」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Differential settlement and track kink"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。
聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift.
Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
quiz.explanation: 採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and track kink: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「沉陷差與軌道坡折」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Differential settlement and track kink” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 高差異常需先查基點，不能立刻推定路基局部下沉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. An unusual level difference requires a datum check before inferring local earthwork settlement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：將建築兩端高差與中間沉陷槽分開，檢查測點密度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Separate end-to-end building difference from an intermediate trough and inspect point spacing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 高差異常需先查基點，不能立刻推定路基局部下沉。
knowledge.textEn: A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. An unusual level difference requires a datum check before inferring local earthwork settlement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「沉陷差與軌道坡折」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Differential settlement and track kink" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
注入漿量超過幾何空隙體積就能證明沒有殘留空洞
基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Injecting more than the geometric void volume proves that no void remains.
A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact.
quiz.explanation: 基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
